title: pilosella auricula
intro: Pilosella auricula, commonly known as Mouse-ear Hawkweed, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues, including gastrointestinal problems, wounds, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Pilosella auricula include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
